Do you price match or honor a price drop after purchase?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, we do offer price matching for price drops that occur after your purchase!
Here's how it works:
If the price of the same item is reduced by Avocado or by an authorized retailer within 30 days after your purchase date, we'll refund the difference to your original form of payment. This policy applies only to future price reductions that occur after your purchase — it does not apply to lower prices, promotions, or discounts that were already available at the time you placed your order.
To request a price adjustment:
Contact our Customer Experience team within 30 days of your order date
Provide proof of the lower advertised price
The item must be identical in model, size, and color, and it must be in stock at the time of the request
If a promotion occurs shortly after your purchase and results in a lower price, you're encouraged to reach out to discuss potential refund options.
